description: This file defines the 'Smarty_Security' class, which manages security settings and enforcement for the Smarty template engine. It includes properties for handling PHP tags, trusted directories, allowed tags, modifiers, functions, constants, streams, and more. The class provides methods to verify whether certain PHP functions, static classes, class methods/properties, tags, variables, or streams are trusted, as well as resource directory checks and security enforcement mechanisms.

classes.name: Smarty_Security
classes.description: Class handling security policies for Smarty templates including trusted directories, functions, tags, constants, and other security-related settings.

methods.name: isTrustedPhpFunction
methods.description: Checks if a PHP function is trusted based on security settings.

methods.name: isTrustedStaticClass
methods.description: Verifies if a static class is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedStaticClassAccess
methods.description: Checks if access to a static class method or property is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedPhpModifier
methods.description: Checks if a PHP modifier is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedTag
methods.description: Verifies if a template tag is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedSpecialSmartyVar
methods.description: Checks if a special $smarty variable is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedModifier
methods.description: Verifies if a modifier plugin is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedConstant
methods.description: Checks if a PHP constant is permitted.

methods.name: isTrustedStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedResourceDir
methods.description: Verifies if a resource file's directory is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedUri
methods.description: Checks if a URI is trusted.

methods.name: isTrustedPHPDir
methods.description: Verifies if a PHP directory is trusted.

methods.name: _updateResourceDir
methods.description: Internal method to update resource directories cache.

methods.name: _checkDir
methods.description: Internal method to verify if a directory is trusted.

methods.name: enableSecurity
methods.description: Static method to enable and initialize security policy for Smarty.

methods.name: startTemplate
methods.description: Begins template processing with security considerations.

methods.name: endTemplate
methods.description: Ends template processing, adjusting nesting counters.

methods.name: registerCallBacks
methods.description: Registers callback functions for template render start/end.
